name: Account Manager
tagline: Assembles call briefings and follow-up drafts so key accounts never start cold
description: Keeps the context on each key account warm by building a briefing for every conversation out of transcripts, CRM entries, your notes and Slack, and it writes the follow-up afterwards too. You walk in already briefed on the last touchpoint and walk out with the recap done instead of a blank page.
author: SpaceX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
